title: Precomposition cylinder from a coherent natural equivalence
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, quasicategories, coherent functor simplicial sets and coherent natural equivalences of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $K$ be a small simplicial set and let $\eta:K\times\Delta^1\to K$ be a simplicial homotopy between maps $u,v:K\to K$. For every quasicategory $\mathcal C$, evaluation and composition define a simplicial map
$$H_\eta:\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C)\times\Delta^1\to\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C),\qquad (F,t)\longmapsto F\circ\eta_t,$$
whose restrictions at the two endpoints are precomposition by $u$ and by $v$, respectively. The construction is natural under simplicial maps of the target $\mathcal C$.

source.place: Construction 1.5.3.1: internal functor simplicial sets and evaluation; the stated cylinder is their explicit composition consequence. Source read online 2026-10-17; archival copy WANTED. Kerodon tag, not a Stacks tag.

proof.text:
Put $D=\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C)$. By [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], an $n$-simplex of $D\times\Delta^1$ is a pair $(f,t)$ with $f:K\times\Delta^n\to\mathcal C$ simplicial and $t:[n]\to[1]$ weakly increasing. Define a map $g_t:K\times\Delta^n\to K\times\Delta^n$ in degree $r$ by
$$g_t(k,a)=(\eta_r(k,t\circ a),a),\qquad k\in K_r,\ a:[r]\to[n].$$
For $\beta:[s]\to[r]$, simpliciality of $\eta$ gives
$$K(\beta)\eta_r(k,t a)=\eta_s(K(\beta)k,t a\beta).$$
Thus applying the operator $\beta$ before or after $g_t$ gives the same pair, so $g_t$ is simplicial. Set $H_{\eta,n}(f,t)=f\circ g_t$, an $n$-simplex of $D$. This uses only the degreewise product and functor definitions in the cited node.

source.place: Construction 1.5.3.1, internal functor simplicial set; explicit degreewise precomposition calculation. Online source read 2026-10-17; archival copy WANTED.

proof.text:
For $\alpha:[m]\to[n]$, write $A_\alpha=\mathrm{id}_K\times\Delta(\alpha)$. The operator on the source of $H_\eta$ sends $(f,t)$ to $(f A_\alpha,t\alpha)$, by [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. On a degree-$r$ pair $(k,a)$, with $a:[r]\to[m]$, both $A_\alpha g_{t\alpha}$ and $g_t A_\alpha$ give
$$(\eta_r(k,t\alpha a),\alpha a).$$
Consequently $H_{\eta,m}(f A_\alpha,t\alpha)=f A_\alpha g_{t\alpha}=f g_t A_\alpha=H_{\eta,n}(f,t)A_\alpha$. This proves compatibility with every simplicial operator, including faces and degeneracies, so the degreewise functions define the required simplicial map $H_\eta$.

proof.text: Let $t$ be the constant $n$-simplex at $0$ or $1$. The endpoint hypotheses on $\eta$ give $g_t=u\times\mathrm{id}_{\Delta^n}$ or $g_t=v\times\mathrm{id}_{\Delta^n}$, respectively, by the formula of step 1. Hence the restrictions of $H_\eta$ are precisely precomposition by $u$ and $v$ on all simplices of the functor simplicial set of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. In particular, for a vertex $F:K\to\mathcal C$, its track is the edge represented by $F\eta:K\times\Delta^1\to\mathcal C$: at a degree-$r$ pair $(k,a)$ it takes the value $F_r(\eta_r(k,a))$. This identifies the construction with the displayed evaluation/composition formula.

source.place: Construction 1.5.3.1, internal functor simplicial set; explicit degreewise precomposition calculation. Online source read 2026-10-17; archival copy WANTED.

proof.text:
For a simplicial map $q:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C'$, postcomposition gives the simplicial map $q_*:D\to\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal C')$: it takes $f$ to $qf$ and commutes with every parameter restriction by associativity, using the functor operators of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For every $(f,t)$,
$$q_*H^{\mathcal C}_{\eta,n}(f,t)=q(fg_t)=(qf)g_t=H^{\mathcal C'}_{\eta,n}(q_*f,t).$$
Thus $q_*H^{\mathcal C}_\eta=H^{\mathcal C'}_\eta(q_*\times\mathrm{id}_{\Delta^1})$, which is the asserted target naturality. No horn filling, equivalence-edge criterion or fibrancy assertion enters this calculation.

lean.statement: theorem precompositionCylinder_endpoints_natural {K : SSet.{u}} (u₀ u₁ : K ⟶ K) (η : K ⊗ Δ[1] ⟶ K) (h₀ : SSet.ι₀ ≫ η = u₀) (h₁ : SSet.ι₁ ≫ η = u₁) (C : SSet.{u}) [Quasicategory C] : (SSet.ι₀ ≫ precompositionCylinder η C = (MonoidalClosed.pre u₀).app C) ∧ (SSet.ι₁ ≫ precompositionCylinder η C = (MonoidalClosed.pre u₁).app C) ∧ (∀ (C' : SSet.{u}) [Quasicategory C'] (q : C ⟶ C'), precompositionCylinder η C ≫ (ihom K).map q = ((ihom K).map q ▷ Δ[1]) ≫ precompositionCylinder η C')
lean.note: The cylinder is constructed explicitly by evaluation and currying. The theorem states the two endpoint restrictions and naturality under target simplicial maps, on the existing internal functor simplicial set of def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones.
